title: Saved-identity v7 persists an immutable authored ID per graph node

needles: a rename keeps the authored ID and diffs as one changed node
deleting either of two same-named nodes leaves the survivor's ID
v7 inspection refuses planted identity defects
v6 migration is deterministic and never guesses continuity
the entropy-free authored-ID salt separates graphs deterministically

installed_sdk.rationale: GraphNode::authored_id, SignalGraph::rename_node, GraphSerializer::migrate_saved_document and LoadResult::identity_node_ids are public host APIs; to_saved_document writes format 7 and inspect_document validates v7 binding consistency while keeping the v6 rules.

needles: authored IDs survive save, load, NodeId renumbering, undo and redo

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: pulp graph save, fmt and canonicalize write saved-identity v7; a v6 input is rewritten as its deterministic migration, and pulp graph diff refuses a v6/v7 pair. No new command or option is added.

needles: graph rewrites migrate a v6 document deterministically and keep v7 IDs

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP operation, schema, or handler is added; the pulp_graph tool does not read or write saved-identity documents.

live_product_control.rationale: IDs are minted on the control thread at node creation; no runtime operation, executor authority or audio-thread path is added. A WebAssembly AudioWorklet build seeds the per-graph salt without an entropy device, so minting works where crypto.getRandomValues is absent.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability or agent manifest entry is added.
